messages:
sara_cs: FYI — Renaissance Health renewal shows as at-risk. API calls down ~78% over last 30d. New ML lead joined last week and rumor of vendor POC. Renewal due in 45 days.

omar_csm: Ugh. Do we have concrete usage numbers + most active routes? I'll pull quick.

jess_support: Ran a quick query: `SELECT SUM(count) FROM api_metrics WHERE customer='renaissance_health' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days';` -> `2,340` (prior 30d was `10,800`). Top route drop: `/v1/embed` (90% drop).

deploybot: [monitoring] alert: customer:renaissance_health — throughput down 76% vs baseline (30d). link: https://ops.redwood/mon/renaissance_health

devon_cso: Thanks. Who's owning outreach? We should do a short triage call with their new ML lead + procurement if possible. Recommend we ask about: recent infra changes, rate limits, seat counts, and competitor POC details.

maria_sales: I'll loop in our AE (cc @maria_sales). Procurement already flagged a shortlist of vendors last month. Need to know if price or perf concerns.

omar_csm: Quick extra data point: latency and error rates unchanged — this looks like usage/feature drop rather than breakage. Could be champion left / internal reprioritization.

sara_cs: Good. Action items: 1) Omar to schedule 30-min triage with ML lead this week. 2) Dev to prep renewal impact summary + usage heatmap. 3) Maria to surface competitive shortlist and procurement timeline. 4) Jess to capture any recent support threads or SSO/keys changes.

omar_csm: On it. Proposed slots: Wed 11am or Thu 3pm PST. Which works for folks?

maria_sales: Thu 3pm works for our AE and procurement.

jess_support: I'll paste related support threads into the calendar invite. Also found one 2w ticket about API key rotation — customer said they updated keys but then stopped calling `/v1/embed`. Might be org-level flag.

devon_cso: Prep note for triage: offer a short dedicated capacity demo (2-week reserved pool) + usage-saving suggestions (KV caching, batching). If they're evaluating a vendor, show unit-cost delta for their actual workload.

sara_cs: Put a simple cost vs latency table in the deck. Keep it < 2 slides.

omar_csm: Scheduled Thu 2026-04-02 15:00 PST. Invite sent to: renaissance-ml-lead, renaissance-procurement, AE.

jess_support: Added support ticket links + API key rotation note in invite.

maria_sales: I'll prep procurement timeline and vendor list.

sara_cs: Great. Also flag renewal owner in SF (Devon) and set reminder 14d before renewal.

devon_cso: Acknowledged. I'll draft playbook after the call: cadence, proposed incentives (2wk free pilot, SLA credits on commitment), and escalation path.

omar_csm: Quick ask — does engineering want to proactively enable prefix caching on their account before the call? Could reduce token costs and make demos smoother.

jess_support: We can enable prefix/KV caching for a trial tenant. Need customer consent; I'll add as an optional checklist item.

sara_cs: Nice. If call goes cold, fallback is a short exec-to-exec check-in with CTO.

maria_sales: :thumbsup: pulling vendor intel now.

devon_cso: Thanks team — will update thread with notes after Thu call.

omar_csm: Quick final — people + roles on invite: `renaissance_ml_lead (Katie), renaissance_procurement (Sam), AE (Marcus), sara_cs, omar_csm, devon_cso, jess_support`.

sara_cs: Perfect. Closing loop here — talk after the triage. :pray:
